question: A vector has initial point $A(2,-1,3)$ and terminal point $B(-3,4,7)$. Find its scalar components and corresponding vector components.
explanation:
Step 1: Calculation of the directed vector
The vector from $A$ to $B$ is
\(\overrightarrow{AB}=[-3-2]\hat{i}+[4-(-1)]\hat{j}+(7-3)\hat{k}\)
Thus,
\(\overrightarrow{AB}=-5\hat{i}+5\hat{j}+4\hat{k}\)
Step 2: Identification of scalar components
The numerical coefficients of $\hat{i}$, $\hat{j}$ and $\hat{k}$ are the scalar components. Hence, they are $-5$, $5$ and $4$.
Step 3: Identification of vector components
The corresponding vector components are $-5\hat{i}$, $5\hat{j}$ and $4\hat{k}$.
Final Answer
Scalar components: $-5,5,4$; vector components: $-5\hat{i},5\hat{j},4\hat{k}$.
